_comment: Verifies reaction_diffusion pitfall 3 on scikit-fem 12.0.1 (2026-08-06). Schnakenberg on 16x16 ElementQuad1 (289 DOFs), dt=2e-3, 10 backward-Euler steps. Started exactly at (u_ss, v_ss) = (1.0, 0.9) the run stays flat, spread 2.97e-08, and the assembled residual at that state is ~1e-13 - the uniform state is an exact discrete equilibrium because laplace @ ones = 0 and f(u_ss, v_ss) = 0. With the recommended 1e-3 perturbation the same run saturates into a pattern, spread 4.48, ratio 1.5e+08. Refinement recorded by the fixture: the unperturbed spread is NOT constant, it grows x5.5 per step from round-off (the backward-Euler amplification of the fastest mode), reaching 4.0e+01 by step 20 during authoring. An unperturbed start delays onset by ~17 steps here; it does not prevent it.
